points.title: 贵族出身
points.description: 柏拉图出生于雅典的一个贵族家庭，原名阿里斯托勒斯（Aristocles）。他的家族拥有政治影响力，这使他从小就接触到雅典的政治生活和社会精英。据说他的导师给他取了'柏拉图'这个绰号，意为'宽阔'，可能源于他宽阔的肩膀或额头。在这个时期，他接受了当时最好的教育，学习诗歌、音乐、哲学和体育，并受到当时著名哲学家苏格拉底的深刻影响。这段经历为他后来的哲学思想奠定了基础，也培养了他对政治和伦理问题的关注。
points.descriptionEn: Plato was born in an aristocratic family in Athens, originally named Aristocles. His family had political influence, exposing him from an early age to Athenian political life and social elites. It is said that his teacher gave him the nickname 'Plato,' meaning 'broad,' possibly due to his broad shoulders or forehead. During this period, he received the best education of the time, studying poetry, music, philosophy, and physical education, and was profoundly influenced by the renowned philosopher Socrates. This experience laid the foundation for his later philosophical thoughts and cultivated his interest in political and ethical issues.

points.title: 师从苏格拉底
points.description: 大约在20岁时，柏拉图开始追随苏格拉底学习，成为他最著名的学生。这一时期对他的人生至关重要，苏格拉底的辩证法和哲学方法深深影响了柏拉图的思想发展。他记录了苏格拉底的对话和教诲，这些记录后来成为他哲学创作的重要素材。公元前399年，苏格拉底被雅典法庭判处死刑，这一事件对柏拉图产生了巨大冲击，使他开始思考理想政治制度和哲学与政治的关系。苏格拉底的死也促使柏拉图离开雅典，开始了他的第一次旅行。
points.descriptionEn: Around the age of 20, Plato began to follow Socrates as his student, becoming his most famous disciple. This period was crucial to his life, as Socrates' dialectical method and philosophical approach profoundly influenced Plato's intellectual development. He recorded Socrates' dialogues and teachings, which later became important material for his philosophical works. In 399 BCE, Socrates was sentenced to death by the Athenian court, a event that had a tremendous impact on Plato, prompting him to reflect on ideal political systems and the relationship between philosophy and politics. Socrates' death also led Plato to leave Athens and begin his first journey abroad.

points.title: 游学四方
points.description: 苏格拉底死后，柏拉图离开雅典，开始了长达12年的游学生涯。他先后访问了埃及、意大利、西西里岛等地。在埃及，他研究了当地的数学和宗教体系；在南意大利，他接触了毕达哥拉斯学派的数学和哲学思想；在西西里岛的叙拉古，他试图说服僭主狄奥尼修斯一世采纳他的政治理念，但失败了。这次旅行极大地拓宽了他的视野，吸收了各地的文化、科学和政治思想，为他后来创作《理想国》等著作积累了丰富的素材。这次游历也使他认识到纯粹哲学理想与现实政治之间的巨大差距。
points.descriptionEn: After Socrates' death, Plato left Athens and began a 12-year journey of study and travel. He visited Egypt, Italy, Sicily, and other places. In Egypt, he studied local mathematics and religious systems; in Southern Italy, he was exposed to the mathematical and philosophical ideas of the Pythagorean school; in Syracuse, Sicily, he attempted to persuade the tyrant Dionysius I to adopt his political ideals, but failed. This journey greatly broadened his horizons, allowing him to absorb various cultural, scientific, and political ideas, which provided rich material for his later works such as 'The Republic.' This experience also made him recognize the vast gap between pure philosophical ideals and real-world politics.

points.title: 创办学园
points.description: 公元前387年，柏拉图回到雅典，在城外的阿卡德米亚（Academia）地区创办了著名的'柏拉图学园'（Academy）。这是西方世界最早的高等教育机构之一，也是欧洲第一所大学。学园不仅教授哲学，还涵盖数学、天文学、政治学等多个学科。柏拉图在此处度过了余生的绝大部分时间，培养了许多杰出的学生，包括亚里士多德。在学园期间，柏拉图完成了他最重要的哲学著作，如《理想国》、《会饮篇》、《斐多篇》等，系统地阐述了他的理念论、政治哲学和伦理思想。学园的存在延续了柏拉图的思想传统，对西方哲学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 387 BCE, Plato returned to Athens and founded his famous 'Academy' in the suburb of Academia. This was one of the earliest institutions of higher education in the Western world and Europe's first university. The Academy not only taught philosophy but also covered mathematics, astronomy, political science, and other disciplines. Plato spent most of his remaining life at the Academy, training many outstanding students, including Aristotle. During this period, Plato completed his most important philosophical works, such as 'The Republic,' 'Symposium,' and 'Phaedo,' systematically expounding his theory of Forms, political philosophy, and ethical ideas. The Academy continued Plato's intellectual tradition and had a profound impact on Western philosophy.

points.title: 政治实践
points.description: 公元前367年，柏拉图应叙拉古僭主狄奥尼修斯二世的邀请，再次前往西西里岛，试图实现他的政治理想。他希望通过教育年轻的狄奥尼修斯二世，将其培养成一位真正的'哲学王'。然而，这次尝试再次以失败告终，柏拉图甚至一度被软禁。尽管如此，他仍然坚持自己的理念，并在第三次访问（约公元前361年）时继续尝试。这些政治实践经历使柏拉图更加认识到理论与实践之间的差距，也促使他进一步完善了《理想国》中的政治哲学思想。最终，柏拉图回到雅典学园，直至公元前348年去世，享年约80岁。
points.descriptionEn: In 367 BCE, Plato was invited to Syracuse again by the young tyrant Dionysius II, attempting to realize his political ideals. He hoped to educate Dionysius II to become a true 'philosopher-king.' However, this attempt also ended in failure, and Plato was even placed under house arrest for a time. Despite these setbacks, Plato persisted in his ideals and made a third visit (around 361 BCE) to continue his efforts. These experiences of political practice made Plato more aware of the gap between theory and practice, prompting him to further develop his political philosophy in 'The Republic.' Eventually, Plato returned to the Academy in Athens, where he died around 348 BCE at approximately 80 years old.

appraisal.zh: 柏拉图作为西方哲学的奠基人，其理念论与辩证法深刻塑造了整个西方哲学传统，《理想国》构建了系统的政治哲学，学园更成为西方学术传统的源头，其对话体也成为哲学表达的经典形式。不过也有研究者指出，理念论脱离具体事物的变化，'哲学王'构想带有精英主义乃至极权色彩，对诗人和艺术的审查主张压制创造力，对数学的推崇与神秘倾向也受质疑。
appraisal.en: Plato stands as a founder of Western philosophy: his theory of Forms and dialectic profoundly shaped the tradition, 'The Republic' built a systematic political philosophy, the Academy became a source of Western scholarship, and his dialogues a classic form of philosophical expression. Yet researchers also point out that the theory of Forms is detached from the change of concrete things, the 'philosopher-kings' ideal is elitist and even totalitarian, his censorship of poets and art suppresses creativity, and his reverence for mathematics and mystical leanings are questioned.

supporter.zh: 柏拉图被誉为西方哲学的奠基人之一，他的理念论和辩证法方法深刻影响了整个西方哲学传统。支持者认为，柏拉图通过《理想国》等著作构建了系统的政治哲学体系，提出了'哲学王'的理想统治模式，强调理性和正义在社会中的核心地位。他的学园培养了众多杰出人才，成为西方学术传统的源头。柏拉图的思想不仅塑造了西方哲学的发展轨迹，也为后来的政治理论、伦理学和形而上学提供了重要基础，是人类思想史上的不朽丰碑。
supporter.en: Plato is hailed as one of the founders of Western philosophy, and his theory of Forms and dialectical method have profoundly influenced the entire Western philosophical tradition. Supporters believe that through works like 'The Republic,' Plato constructed a systematic political philosophy, proposing the ideal rule of 'philosopher-kings' and emphasizing the central role of reason and justice in society. His Academy trained numerous outstanding talents, becoming the source of Western academic tradition. Plato's thoughts not only shaped the trajectory of Western philosophy but also provided important foundations for later political theory, ethics, and metaphysics, making him an immortal monument in the history of human thought.

critic.zh: 批评者指出柏拉图的哲学体系存在明显缺陷，尤其是他的理念论被认为脱离现实，无法解释具体事物的变化和发展。在政治方面，柏拉图的'哲学王'构想被批评为精英主义和反民主的，他的理想国实际上是一种极权主义模式，限制了个人自由。此外，柏拉图对艺术和诗人的批判（如在《理想国》中主张审查文艺作品）也被视为对文化创造力的压制。他的思想中的神秘主义倾向和对数学的过度崇拜也受到质疑，被认为阻碍了科学方法的自然发展。
critic.en: Critics point out that Plato's philosophical system has significant flaws, especially his theory of Forms, which is considered detached from reality and unable to explain the change and development of concrete things. Politically, Plato's concept of 'philosopher-kings' has been criticized as elitist and anti-democratic, with his ideal state essentially being a totalitarian model that limits individual freedom. Additionally, Plato's criticism of art and poets (advocating for censorship of artistic works in 'The Republic') is seen as suppressing cultural creativity. The mystical tendencies in his thought and excessive worship of mathematics have also been questioned,被认为阻碍了科学方法的自然发展。

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，柏拉图作为西方哲学的奠基人，其影响已超越纯粹的学术领域，成为西方文明的重要象征。他的著作和思想通过中世纪经院哲学、文艺复兴和新柏拉图主义等不同历史阶段被重新诠释和传承，持续塑造着西方思想传统。在当代，柏拉图的思想元素广泛出现在政治理论、教育哲学、伦理学等多个领域。他的对话体写作风格也成为哲学表达的经典形式。柏拉图的形象在流行文化中常被智慧、沉思和理想主义的象征，尽管他的某些观点在现代看来可能显得过时，但他的核心问题和方法论——关于真理、正义、美和知识的本质探讨——仍然是哲学思考的核心议题。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Plato as a founder of Western philosophy has influenced beyond purely academic domains, becoming an important symbol of Western civilization. His works and ideas have been reinterpreted and transmitted through different historical periods such as medieval scholasticism, Renaissance, and Neoplatonism, continuously shaping Western thought. In contemporary times, elements of Plato's thought appear in various fields including political theory, educational philosophy, and ethics. His dialogical writing style has also become a classic form of philosophical expression. In popular culture, Plato is often symbolized by wisdom, contemplation, and idealism. While some of his views may seem outdated today, his core questions and methodology regarding the nature of truth, justice, beauty, and knowledge remain central philosophical issues.

self.en: Wonder is the feeling of a philosopher, and philosophy is nothing other than wonder.
